plugin.name: meta-insights
plugin.description: Read-only Facebook Page and Instagram Business insights: reach, engagement, profile views, follower counts, and post performance including boosted reach
plugin.context: Use to understand how a business's Facebook Page and Instagram presence is performing. Provides audience reach, impressions, engagement, profile views and website clicks over time, plus per-post performance that separates organic from paid (boosted) reach. This plugin is READ-ONLY: it cannot post content, create ads, or change any setting. For advertising operations use the meta-ads plugin instead.

auth_config._scope_note: Only scopes the Meta app can actually grant may be listed here: one unavailable scope fails the ENTIRE OAuth dialog with 'Invalid Scopes', not just that permission. read_insights, instagram_basic and instagram_manage_insights were rejected by the app as configured — read_insights needs a Business-type app, and the instagram_* pair needs the Instagram product added. Add them back to this array once the app dashboard reports them available; get_page_insights and get_instagram_insights cannot work until then. See docs/plugins/meta-insights-plugin.md.

list_pages.description: List the Facebook Pages this user manages, each with its linked Instagram Business account if one exists
list_pages.usage_context: Call first after connecting. Most businesses manage exactly one Page, in which case the caller should select it automatically rather than asking the user to choose.

picture_url.description: Page profile picture, for showing in a chooser

instagram_account_id.description: Linked Instagram Business account ID, or null when the Page has none

output_guidance.success_description: Returns every Page the user administers, with the linked Instagram Business account where one is connected
output_guidance.common_errors: Empty list when the user administers no Pages, or when the Page role is insufficient. instagram_account_id is null unless the Instagram account is a Business or Creator account linked to the Page — personal Instagram accounts cannot be read.

get_page_insights.description: Daily reach, impressions, engagement and profile activity for a Facebook Page over a date range
get_page_insights.usage_context: Use to show how a Page's visibility is trending. Returns one row per day so results can be stored and charted; do not use for a single aggregate number.

since.description: Start date, ISO 8601 (e.g. '2026-06-01'). Defaults to 30 days ago. Meta serves at most 93 days per call.

until.description: End date, ISO 8601. Defaults to today.

page_token.description: Page-scoped access token. Page and Instagram insights reject the user token with error #190. Resolved automatically when omitted.

impressions.description: Times any Page content entered a screen

reach.description: Distinct people who saw any Page content

engagements.description: Distinct people who clicked, reacted, commented or shared

followers_count.description: Current follower total. A snapshot at retrieval time, not a per-day value.

output_guidance.success_description: Returns one row per day in the range, plus the Page's current follower count
output_guidance.common_errors: Metrics can be absent for days before the Page had activity — treat a missing metric as zero, not as an error. Ranges longer than 93 days are rejected by Meta and must be split. Requires the read_insights permission at Advanced Access to work for Pages the app user does not administer.

get_instagram_insights.description: Daily reach, impressions and profile activity for an Instagram Business account
get_instagram_insights.usage_context: Use alongside get_page_insights to show Instagram's contribution. Requires an Instagram Business or Creator account linked to a Facebook Page.

instagram_account_id.description: Instagram Business account ID from list_pages

since.description: Start date, ISO 8601. Defaults to 30 days ago. Instagram serves at most 30 days per call.

until.description: End date, ISO 8601. Defaults to today.

page_token.description: Page-scoped access token. Page and Instagram insights reject the user token with error #190. Resolved automatically when omitted.

website_clicks.description: Taps on the website link in the bio

output_guidance.success_description: Returns one row per day plus the account's current follower count
output_guidance.common_errors: Fails when the account is personal rather than Business/Creator — surface that as an instruction to switch account type, not as a generic error. Instagram limits insights to 30 days per request; longer ranges must be chunked. Accounts under 100 followers may have metrics withheld for privacy.

get_recent_posts.description: Recent Page posts with their reach, split into organic and paid (boosted)
get_recent_posts.usage_context: Use to show which posts performed and whether a boost was involved. Paid reach appears here without any advertising permission, but the amount SPENT on a boost is not available through this endpoint.

limit.description: Maximum posts to return, newest first

since.description: Only posts published on or after this ISO 8601 date

message.description: Post text, may be absent for image-only posts

impressions_paid.description: Impressions from a boost. Greater than zero means this post was promoted.

output_guidance.success_description: Returns recent posts newest first, each with organic and paid impressions
output_guidance.common_errors: Per-post insight metrics are unavailable for very recent posts until Meta has processed them; treat missing values as zero. Boost SPEND is not exposed by this endpoint at any permission level — do not attempt to derive cost or ROAS from it.
